contract.empty_registry_emit: EventBus.emit() succeeds when the listener registry is empty
contract.empty_registry_delivery: An empty listener registry produces no callback delivery
contract.registration_activation: A registered callback becomes active for subsequent emits
contract.cleanup: Successful unregistration removes the callback and restores the empty registry state
contract.post_cleanup_emit: Emit remains successful after listener cleanup
contract.repeated_empty_emit: Repeated emits against an empty registry remain successful and side-effect free
contract.registry_stability: Repeated empty-registry emits do not mutate the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus emit and callback operations require the events permission
